content: I'm not willing to front the full deposit myself because I'm still annoyed about the group meal money last year.
I'm aware the deadline is tight and I need to get a response from Dev and Nina soon.
I really want to go but the £200 deposit is impossible for me until payday on the 28th, and I promised my wife I'd stop using the credit card.
I'm aware I need to reply eventually, but with mum just out of hospital I can't plan October yet. I'll check back when I know more.
I'm not going to pay the deposit now; I'll wait until payday on the 28th and risk the trip being full.
I'm starting to get a bit anxious about the deadline, but I'm not going to chase them tonight. I'll follow up tomorrow morning if I still haven't heard anything.
I'm getting frustrated that they haven't replied yet; I might need to call them if I don't hear back today.
I've now replied to Ruth explaining my situation, so she knows I'm not bailing, just delayed.
I've messaged Ruth, so now it's up to her to respond.
I'm getting worried that silence means they might not be interested anymore, but I'm not giving up yet.
The deadline has passed without deposit, so the hold is cancelled.
